svg.aria-label: Space–time heatmap and concentration profiles of the same ideal planar membrane: thickness 0.5 mm, D=10⁻⁶ cm²/s, internal upstream concentration 50 μg/mL and zero downstream concentration. Color scale and profile axes use the same concentration definition.
